rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 3's new close, "Ask Claude to push the branch to the remote." — "the branch" was named two chunks earlier (chunk 2 header "Pin the starting point" + "commit current state on a feature branch"), in-file reuse, not a violation. Chunk 5's new close, "If Claude stalls, ask it to keep going — the nudge is phrased as encouragement and lands as a taunt." — "it" resolves to "Claude" in the same clause; "the nudge" resolves to the instruction just given ("ask it to keep going"), itself an instance of the "Nudge by hand" bullet earlier in the SAME chunk (line 74) — both antecedents sit inside chunk 5, no forward or cross-file pointer.
No chunk points at another file by position. Both new lead-ins ("push the branch to the remote", "the nudge is phrased as encouragement") are in-file, in-chunk statements, not callbacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 0's "The same session that ran the audit" is the only backward beat reference in the file; "the audit" resolves against the module's actual preceding exercise (`walk-and-send-off.md`, included immediately above this file under "## Send the task off" in `run-the-first-experiment.md`, and its Key Concepts line "The audit ranked the thin spots..."). Beat exists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal beat anywhere in the file.
Every chunk carries header + instruction + prompt fence (chunk 4 is thinnest at 14 words but still states the whole send-off instruction plus its prompt). No chunk is a bare wait-state.
"While it runs" is borne out by its own bullets (keep laptop awake, nudge by hand, stop if off the rails) plus the new closing line about stalls — content matches header at slide scope.

No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction, no anaphora/epistrophe triple, no self-grading superlative, no abstraction-noun stack, no empty-leg verb triplet in any chunk. "Past ten or so interventions" (chunk 5) is a suggestion-register pacing calibration per the file's own maintainer block (§16 boundary clause), not the banned number-plus-retraction tic — it never retracts itself, it calibrates with "or so."

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo/authorial vocabulary (compendium, forcing function, beat, mood, surface-as-noun) anywhere in the body chunks (0-5); those terms appear only below the maintainer cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Only bolded elements are the field-label handles in chunk 0 (Time/Session/What you do/What you build/The point) and the "Prompt" widget handles inside fences (exempt). No bolded lead sentences in any body chunk.
